newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop seen curbing flatsale speculation.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop seen curbing flatsale speculation.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said it has introduced a new sales system for its latest sale of residential flats at East Point City in Tseung Kwan O, in a move widely seen as an attempt to reduce property speculation.
A company spokeswoman said the new system would restrict the number of potential home buyers who registered under limited companies to a maximum of 20 for every 100 registered buyers.
The sequence of choosing flats will be decided through ballots, the spokeswoman said.
